title: CheckResult
description: The document printed by `notlob check --format json`: the findings of the semantic checks over the project name-graph. Stdout holds only this document. Exit code is 1 when any finding has severity `error`, else 0, whatever the --format. If the graph cannot be built because two things in one module share a name, the document holds a single `names` finding and an empty `counts`. If there is no project (no binding.lob), nothing is printed to stdout, an error goes to stderr, and the exit code is 1. `version` is bumped on a breaking change.

findings.description: Every finding from the checks that ran, in check order.

counts.description: Number of findings per check, including checks that found nothing (0). With `--only`, only the checks that ran appear; empty when no check could run.

CheckFinding.description: One semantic-check finding. This definition appears in both check_result.json (`notlob check --format json`) and test_result.json (the `checks` list of `notlob test --format json`); a test keeps the two identical.

check.description: Which check produced it. `names` is the synthetic finding `notlob test --format json` reports for an address collision (two things in one module sharing a name); it is not a check `notlob check` runs.

addresses.description: Addresses of the nodes the finding concerns.
